basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old tech enthusiast originally from Mexico, now living in Seattle. By day, I'm a systems analyst specializing in network security, and by night, I'm an avid DIY PC builder and watercooling aficionado. I love sharing my builds and learning from others in the community. Besides tech, I enjoy painting Warhammer miniatures, especially Iron Warriors. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington and over five years of experience in IT security, I've developed a strong foundation in network systems and cybersecurity. My passion for technology also drives me to continually learn through online courses and hands-on experience with PC hardware.
